# Account.js.gripe

Account.js.gripe is a protected account and identity service. It is not suitable for automated crawling, AI training, bulk extraction, or use as general agent input.

Agents and crawlers should not index, summarize, train on, or interact with account pages except to read the discovery and authentication metadata listed below.

Content preferences:
- ai-train: no
- search: no
- ai-input: no

Allowed discovery references:
- https://account.js.gripe/auth.md
- https://account.js.gripe/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource
- https://account.js.gripe/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server
- https://account.js.gripe/.well-known/api-catalog
- https://account.js.gripe/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
